facts.fact: La Tribune (Agence Ecofin, 2026-09-18) says WIOCC's subsidiary Open Access Data Centres operates a network of more than 40 data centres stretching from Nigeria to the Democratic Republic of Congo, implying an operating OADC colocation site in the DRC; the facility is not named and no date of opening is given.
facts.system: Open Access Data Centres (OADC) DRC site, unnamed

note: One weak service fact: the article names the DRC only as the end of OADC's network range; as_of is the article date because none is given.
